calls.title: Ayhan and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: The meeting addressed the strategic shift towards three primary campaigns focusing on fintech, edtech, and high-traffic B2C sectors, moving away from B2B SaaS due to targeting challenges. Ashley Stirrup emphasized the importance of addressing real user pain points in messaging, particularly around A/B testing tools. Pricila Reyes will revise messaging to highlight Growth Book's self-hosting capabilities. The team agreed on a collaborative rollout process, with hands-on feedback loops to refine lists and assets while maintaining high-quality standards. A new Sales Development Representative (SDR) was introduced to convert leads, and there will be regular check-ins to enhance communication and adaptability in strategy execution, ultimately aimed at maximizing campaign effectiveness and market penetration.
calls.keywords: Campaign Strategy, Messaging, Vertical Targeting, List Building, A/B Testing, Asset Approval

calls.title: ayhan and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: The team discussed strategies for targeting new high-value segments beyond FinTech and B2C, prioritizing EdTech and AI, while considering gaming and gambling for messaging. They emphasized targeting headless CMS-based e-commerce rather than traditional Shopify users, focusing on stores with at least 100,000 monthly visitors for experimentation. The media and publishing vertical was identified for content monetization efforts, emphasizing the importance of linking experimentation with business KPIs through data tools. Ongoing campaigns in FinTech and B2C are still in early phases as the team plans to launch an Adobe Target campaign leveraging asset materials. A focus on personalized outbound sales messaging is aimed at targeting product teams rather than marketing roles to enhance engagement and conversion.
calls.keywords: Audience Targeting, Interactive Lead Magnet, Headless E-commerce, AI Readiness Quiz, Intent Data, Technographic Research

calls.title: ayhan and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: The team discussed enhancing their cold email outreach by shifting from broad solution-focused messaging to targeted approaches grounded in customer pain points. Ayhan emphasized the importance of utilizing anonymized case studies to make messaging more relevant and compelling. Through a new segmentation strategy, the campaign will focus on product-based targeting rather than industry, tailoring messages to specific personas such as product managers and engineers. Content assets will be sourced from existing customer evidence to increase case studies from six to fifteen, while detailed persona archetypes for engineers and product managers have been developed to address high-velocity experimentation challenges. Additionally, a multi-signal lead scoring model will identify high-potential accounts, ensuring effective outreach.
calls.keywords: experimentation, cold email campaigns, content assets, buyer personas, lead scoring, high-velocity testing
